status: retrospective held-out replay on previously inspected datasets; no fresh independent confirmation
question: Can measured same-condition reference information estimate the value of sparse conditional branches, accounting for wrong elimination and acquisition cost?

model.initial: per-hypothesis grouped target-condition reference counts plus Jeffreys 0.5 per registered label
model.conditional: matching paired-reference group counts plus 2.0 times parent probabilities; parent uses same target condition/hypothesis/decoy, excludes whole groups in local counts, and has Jeffreys 0.5 per label
model.groups: SciPlex3 skeleton; L1000 connected identity/scaffold component; one unit of weight per group
model.no_local: explicit marginal backoff, assumes within-hypothesis conditional exchangeability; never claims paired support
model.no_parent: local counts plus Jeffreys 0.5; no duplication of measured counts
model.no_target: unknown with named refusal; never a zero-value estimate
model.hyperparameters: fixed before new replay; no parameter or price tuning on held-out outcomes
model.uncertainty: Dirichlet branch utility variance and beta wrong-risk upper bounds; borrowed mass kept separate from measured support; diagnostic intervals are model-conditional, not validated frequentist coverage

policy.objective: expected terminal utility minus price per expected measurement, including both first and contingent second measurement
policy.cost_interpretation: user economic sensitivity in units of a correct decision; no price declared optimal
policy.first: bounded two-step lookahead using first-reading probabilities under both hypotheses; forecasts conditional on passing QC, assay failure probabilities are not modelled
policy.after_real_result: replan from actually measured action and observed label; QC failure uses unconditional forecasts and consumes budget
policy.stop: no legal action; expected net value non-positive; or all forecasts unknown (distinct reason)
policy.evidence: forecasts and planning weights never update EvidenceState; only registered interpretation of executed real results
policy.risk: wrong elimination charged 2 units; report posterior wrong probability and uncertainty, no unvalidated chance constraint

validation.split: existing five grouped folds; reference estimator receives only fold training tables; no held-out identity or profile input
validation.shared_rules: sequence_audit.run_matched; two assays; nondecreasing exposure; no repetition; QC continue for all; 16 assay-days SciPlex3 and 12 L1000
ablations_at_price_0.02: marginal_only (retains first-reading planning weights, removes conditional response distributions)
validation.primary_comparisons: new policy vs repaired fallback and da_unconditioned, using the SAME measurement price for every arm
validation.interval: 2000 paired component/skeleton bootstrap draws, seed 20260926; L1000 batch sensitivity where feasible
validation.decision: report all prices and all tiers, no search for a favorable price; no global default promotion from previously inspected data
